_comment: What mpv 0.41.0 answered over its JSON IPC socket, measured 2026-10-29 for scripts/qa-stub-mpv.py, which must answer every modelled step of every transcript identically (its --self-test replays them). Each player: prlimit --core=0, timeout 20, env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE -u DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS, a private HOME and XDG tree, --no-config --vo=null --ao=null, one connection, every command in the order listed, exit status 0 and nothing on stderr; the crash journal unchanged. The runtime directory is rewritten to /run/iptv-stub and argv[0] to mpv. These are measurements: edit them only by measuring again. The two transcripts pinned-p1c and prepin-p1c (lane-p1c, 2026-10-29: the tree's launch argv after the format list, prefetch and console pins, and sec-int 124589e's before them) were taken the same way except that prlimit execs mpv directly, with no timeout wrapper, and the player is stopped by the pid held.

transcripts.name: pinned
transcripts.what: a player launched with the tree's launch argv after the pin block landed (mpv_launch_argv, the user's mpvArgs being --vo=null --ao=null): what every player this plugin now starts holds

transcripts.name: prepin
transcripts.what: a player launched with dev 713afbf's launch argv, which has no pin block: what an ADOPTED player started by 0.15.0 or earlier holds

transcripts.name: argv-a
transcripts.what: a bare player with the key-value list set, appended and cleared, the auto-profiles choice set to yes and a flag negated on the command line

transcripts.name: argv-b
transcripts.what: a bare player with the other list forms (-append, -clr, a plain set, -add), a bare flag and a choice set on the command line

transcripts.name: argv-c
transcripts.what: a bare player with empty values on three flags and the tri-state after an explicit no (mpv reads an empty value as yes), and the key-value lists' -remove form

transcripts.name: argv-d
transcripts.what: a bare player with the tri-state negated after a yes, and the third osd-playlist-entry word

transcripts.name: runtime-b
transcripts.what: runtime sets the first four transcripts did not make: a sub-path of a key-value list, change-list del, an empty string on a flag and on the tri-state, a fractional number, and osd-playlist-entry both

transcripts.name: pinned-p1c
transcripts.what: a player launched with the tree's launch argv after lane-p1c's pins (the format list, prefetch and the console off), the user's mpvArgs being --vo=null --ao=null

transcripts.name: prepin-p1c
transcripts.what: a player launched with sec-int 124589e's launch argv, the pin block before lane-p1c: what a player of that build holds when this one adopts it
